com.ibm.cos.v2.core.interceptor

Class ExecutionInterceptorChain

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.ibm.cos.v2.core.interceptor.ExecutionInterceptorChain

  • public class ExecutionInterceptorChain
extends Object
    A wrapper for a list of ExecutionInterceptors that ensures the interceptors are executed in the correct order as it is documented in the ExecutionInterceptor documentation. Interceptors are invoked in forward order up to beforeTransmission(com.ibm.cos.v2.core.interceptor.Context.BeforeTransmission, com.ibm.cos.v2.core.interceptor.ExecutionAttributes) and in reverse order after (and including) afterTransmission(com.ibm.cos.v2.core.interceptor.Context.AfterTransmission, com.ibm.cos.v2.core.interceptor.ExecutionAttributes). This ensures the last interceptors to modify the request are the first interceptors to see the response.
